description: Natural Gas Consumption by ZIP Code - 2010 is a dataset listed in City of New York open data portal (data.cityofnewyork.us), an open data portal (Socrata) of a city, published or maintained by City of New York. 2010 Natural Gas consumption in therms and GJ, by ZIP code, building type, and utility company. Coverage: New York City. The portal files it under the category Environment. Its tags are gas, energy, power, planning, environment. The table has 14 columns. Attribution on the portal: Mayor's Office of Climate and Environmental Justice (MOCEJ). The portal shows 2013-06-21 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support gas network and biomethane studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-cityofnewyork-us-portal.
